reason: A session-management utility that adds sidebar and HTTP API controls for permanently deleting inactive DeepSeek Harness sessions and their stored artifacts.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏菜单和 HTTP API，用于删除会话及其关联的工作区记录和磁盘文件。
summaries.en: Adds sidebar and HTTP API controls to delete DeepSeek Harness sessions along with their associated workspace records and disk artifacts.

capabilities: Deletes DeepSeek Harness sessions through a web sidebar menu
Exposes a session deletion HTTP endpoint
Removes session artifact directories, workspace records, and live-store entries
